## About
World Tire Wholesale runs a retail center on Dowd Ave in Elizabeth where you can pick up your tires or have them installed. Call our sales team and they will help you choose, finalize your order and set it up for pick-up or installation. There is no showroom, so calling ahead is the way to go.
We also run Road Service Express for trucks and fleets. If you get a flat or run out of fuel, our mobile service trucks come out with replacement fuel, tires and tools at any hour of the day or night.
Customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 239 Google reviews, and we are grateful to every one of them.

## Services
- 24-hour Road Service Express: Flat tire on the road or ran out of fuel? Call us any day of the week and our mobile service trucks will come with replacement fuel, tires and servicing tools.
- Heavy duty truck tire service: Tire service for tractor trailers, semi-trucks, fleet vehicles, dump trucks, buses and more, at any hour of the day or night.
- Order pick-up and installation: A member of our sales team will help with your purchase and finalize your order for pick-up or installation at our Elizabeth retail center.

## FAQ
Q: Do you have a showroom?
A: No, a showroom is not available. Call our sales team and they will help you place your order for pick-up or installation.

Q: What do I need to bring to pick up an online order?
A: The credit card holder needs to be there and show the card used to pay, along with a photo ID. We will make a copy of the ID and ask you to sign for your order.

Q: What are your retail center hours?
A: We are open 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Monday through Friday and 8:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. on Saturday. We are closed Sunday.
